---
title: "Apps gateway on Vite+ and Cloudflare"
description: "Validate the additive public Apps gateway without changing canonical traffic."
---

The staging gateway is a separate public catalogue and redirect entry. It does not
replace the existing Next Apps app, authenticated launcher, workspace controls or
account-assurance flow. Those continue on `https://apps.tuturuuu.com`.

## Build and validation

Run the owning `test:cloudflare` script for route, cookie, header and catalogue
controls. Require `build:cloudflare` and a built Worker runtime check in exact-commit
CI. Existing Next scripts stay unchanged and their build remains required. Vite+
builds the separate portable catalogue and Worker entry; it does not port Next APIs.

The staging config names `tuturuuu-apps-vite-staging` with no production custom
domain, database, scheduler, secret or durable-state binding. Local preview must
keep remote bindings disabled. Source configuration does not prove a deployed app.

## Public and authenticated behavior

App aliases and redirect destinations come from the existing shared catalogue.
Unknown app/API routes return 404, mutations return 405, and destinations cannot
be chosen by a query parameter. Encoded path segments and repeated query values
are preserved, including the existing default `source=apps` marker.

Explicit English/Vietnamese prefixes redirect to the prefix-free route and set
a host-only `NEXT_LOCALE` cookie. The host-only scope is intentional for isolated
staging; any production shared-domain cookie treatment needs its own qualification.
The catalogue reads that cookie and the language header, renders meaningful HTML
before hydration, and keeps theme selection from the browser's existing `theme`
value without writing a preference. Native controls remain keyboard accessible.

Entries with app-session/Supabase cookies or any explicit Authorization header
return to the original Apps origin for its existing authentication and assurance
checks. This fallback does not validate credentials or grant access. The public
Worker never proxies authenticated APIs. Replies are private/no-store and vary
with cookie, authorization and language. Staging is noindex; the Worker rejects
requests addressed to the canonical production host. Full font/design/authenticated
provider and production SEO parity are still separate acceptance gates.

## Staging and rollback

No deployment command is part of this slice. Before a staging deployment, verify
the account, isolated target, emitted Worker/assets, source SHA, required provider
authority and rollback plan. Build-info reports only a supplied source SHA; absence
is not success. The source field is not a substitute for artifact provenance.

Preserve the original Next/Vercel artifact and route until the full app meets
parity and an explicit scoped traffic switch is authorized. Rollback restores
the prior route/artifact; this public slice never changes customer data or durable
state. Do not run a global Vite+ migrator or refresh paused Rust/TanStack runtimes
to complete this app-local port.
